strings.name: Jared Isaacman
strings.role: NASA administrator, entrepreneur and commercial astronaut
strings.summary: American entrepreneur, pilot and commercial astronaut Jared Isaacman became NASA’s 15th administrator in December 2025. He founded a payments business, co-founded Draken and commanded Inspiration4 and Polaris Dawn. Spaceflight achievements involve crews, SpaceX and research partners.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Current public office is distinguished from former corporate roles. Firsts retain commercial or orbital qualifications; agency achievements are not all personal accomplishments.
strings.influence.rationale: Participates in private human spaceflight and related technical practice, advancing commercial spaceflight, research cooperation and public participation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Aeronautics education
strings.facts.f1.value: Embry-Riddle aeronautics bachelor’s in 2011; the 2024 honorary doctorate is an honorary award, not a research doctorate.
strings.facts.f2.label: Corporate succession
strings.facts.f2.value: After leaving the Shift4 CEO role in June 2025, he became executive chairman and left its board upon Senate confirmation in December. Taylor Lauber succeeded him.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Commercial human spaceflight
strings.highlights.h1.text: Commanded two orbital missions and joined Sarah Gillis in a commercial spacewalk and suit tests, with contributions from the other crew and engineering teams.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Entrepreneurship and public management
strings.highlights.h2.text: Moved from payments and aviation-training ventures into NASA leadership. Agency budgets, audits and mission results require separate assessment.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Statement on NASA financial audit
strings.timeline.t1.text: Agency release quotes its current administrator and reports a 16th consecutive unmodified financial-statement opinion; not a personal award or certification of every program.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Sworn in as NASA administrator
strings.timeline.t2.text: Senate confirmation came the previous day. Oath, confirmation and departure from the Shift4 board are distinct dates.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Shift4 CEO transition
strings.timeline.t3.text: Filing records June 4 resignation and June 5 executive-chair appointment; Lauber became CEO June 5. Board service continued until December.
strings.timeline.t4.title: First commercial spacewalk
strings.timeline.t4.text: During Polaris Dawn, he and Sarah Gillis exited in sequence to test SpaceX suits; this was a team achievement.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Commands Inspiration4 launch
strings.timeline.t5.text: Four civilians launched on an orbital flight on this Florida local date; the first was specifically an all-civilian orbital mission.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Earns aeronautics bachelor’s
strings.timeline.t6.text: Embry-Riddle confirms the graduation year; the subject is not aerospace engineering.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds Draken International
strings.timeline.t7.text: Developed contracted aviation training in Lakeland, Florida; distinct from the history of British predecessors later incorporated into the group.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Starts payments business
strings.timeline.t8.text: Founded United Bank Card, whose business developed into Shift4; the early business origin is not the incorporation date of the later listed holding company.
